{
    "sla_rules": [
        {
            "rule_id": "RULE_001",
            "metric": "AvailabilityImpactPercentage",
            "threshold": 99.0,
            "threshold_operator": "<",
            "penalty_amount": 500,
            "penalty_type": "monetary",
            "penalty_percentage": 5,
            "description": "5% penalty per month if availability impact is below 99%",
            "applicable_period": "monthly"
        },
        {
            "rule_id": "RULE_002",
            "metric": "InitialResponseTimeMinutes",
            "threshold": 15,
            "threshold_operator": ">",
            "penalty_amount": 200,
            "penalty_type": "monetary",
            "penalty_percentage": 2,
            "description": "2% penalty per incident if initial response time exceeds 15 minutes",
            "applicable_period": "per incident"
        },
        {
            "rule_id": "RULE_003",
            "metric": "ResolutionTimeMinutes",
            "threshold": 60,
            "threshold_operator": ">",
            "penalty_amount": 300,
            "penalty_type": "monetary",
            "penalty_percentage": 3,
            "description": "3% penalty per incident if resolution time exceeds 60 minutes",
            "applicable_period": "per incident"
        },
        {
            "rule_id": "RULE_004",
            "metric": "QueryFailureRatePercentage",
            "threshold": 1.0,
            "threshold_operator": ">",
            "penalty_amount": 250,
            "penalty_type": "monetary",
            "penalty_percentage": 2.5,
            "description": "2.5% penalty per month if query failure rate exceeds 1%",
            "applicable_period": "monthly"
        }
    ],
    "violation_conditions": [
        {
            "metric": "AvailabilityImpactPercentage",
            "condition": "AvailabilityImpactPercentage < 99",
            "penalty_rule": "5% penalty per month if availability impact is below 99%"
        },
        {
            "metric": "InitialResponseTimeMinutes",
            "condition": "InitialResponseTimeMinutes > 15",
            "penalty_rule": "2% penalty per incident if initial response time exceeds 15 minutes"
        },
        {
            "metric": "ResolutionTimeMinutes",
            "condition": "ResolutionTimeMinutes > 60",
            "penalty_rule": "3% penalty per incident if resolution time exceeds 60 minutes"
        },
        {
            "metric": "QueryFailureRatePercentage",
            "condition": "QueryFailureRatePercentage > 1",
            "penalty_rule": "2.5% penalty per month if query failure rate exceeds 1%"
        }
    ],
    "sql_query": "SELECT DetectedAt, CASE WHEN AvailabilityImpactPercentage < 99 THEN 500 * (100/99 - AvailabilityImpactPercentage/99) WHEN InitialResponseTimeMinutes > 15 THEN 200 * (InitialResponseTimeMinutes/15) WHEN ResolutionTimeMinutes > 60 THEN 300 * (ResolutionTimeMinutes/60) WHEN QueryFailureRatePercentage > 1 THEN 250 * (QueryFailureRatePercentage/1) ELSE 0 END AS PenaltyAmount FROM incidents_database_service ORDER BY DetectedAt",
    "data_fields_required": ["DetectedAt", "AvailabilityImpactPercentage", "InitialResponseTimeMinutes", "ResolutionTimeMinutes", "QueryFailureRatePercentage"],
    "monthly_service_fee": 10000,
    "max_monthly_penalty_percentage": 30
}
